study: Research fashion in ICLR titles (with abstracts), 2017-2026

data.split: discovery (~80%); held-out confirmation split not requested
data.pools: all submissions incl. rejected, withdrawn and desk-rejected

language: Associational throughout; declared profile keys are not persons; list position is a partition label, not seniority; acceptance associations are subject to the camera-ready caveat; nothing is attributed causally to ChatGPT or any tool.

prereg.reason: Post-audit corrections before any held-out data were requested or seen (no guard file, no heldout.json): (1) the D3 and D4 fixer passes changed required code hashed by revision 1 (d3_register.py, d3_slots.py, d3_vintage.py, d4_bias_atlas.py, d4_stage_gains.py; the frozen test definitions they supply are unchanged); (2) the WP4 enlargement finished (2,004 lines, 2,000 records) and the gate audit is re-frozen on WP4's complete audit; (3) the gate adopts WP4's multiplicity-controlled rule (identification p with the tipping point's sampling error, Holm at 0.025, editing-corrected interval), because the revision-1 uncorrected rule admits acceptance associations that the Holm gate rejects. The R1 models, centroids, lexicons, slot inventory, DFL cells and every test statistic are unchanged (frozen files byte-identical).
prereg.gate_rule: WP4 multiplicity-controlled gate (revision 2). Association claims (CT6 G_total, CT10): the marker must be auditable (>= 10 v1-present per arm and measurable through arXiv metadata), its editing-corrected 95% interval (bootstrap replicate paired with an audit draw D ~ N(D_hat, se_D)) must lie beyond the claim's boundary, and its one-sided identification p, z = (D_hat - D*)/sqrt(se_D^2 + se_D*^2) with se_D the pseudo-flip SE and se_D* the bootstrap SE of the tipping point, must survive Holm at 0.025 across the run's auditable association claims. Equivalence claims (CT5, CT11): editing-corrected interval rules (CT5 = WP4 G1 TOST; CT11 = ACC-pair CIs widened by the largest editing bias inside the NAME audit CI).

robust_findings.claim: ICLR submissions titled 'NAME: subtitle' doubled from 2023 to 2026 (20.3% -> 40.5% of 43,482 submissions), on a trend that became convex (accelerated) from about 2022-24, most visibly in 2026.
robust_findings.evidence: LPM slope change +2.8 pp/yr [1.3, 4.4] (year level); camera-ready-free pool year-level OR 1.121 [1.019, 1.232]; misclassification-corrected ITS within 10% (V1).
robust_findings.caveat: Not a dated 2024 break; not tied to ChatGPT.

robust_findings.claim: A published-only study reproduces the all-submission NAME share, and this survives correction for camera-ready editing.
robust_findings.caveat: A small decision-stage NAME premium (G_dec 1.05) is not identified against editing.

robust_findings.claim: In meaning-fixed title-opener slots, LLM-favoured verbs ('Enhancing' over 'Improving', etc.) rose from 2024 while control pairs did not shift at 2024, including in the camera-ready-free pool; the new openers were added rather than swapped for neutral synonyms.
robust_findings.evidence: Pooled post OR 2.18 [1.41, 3.38]; stacked slot-vs-control 2.55 [1.53, 4.25]; NA pool 2.18 [1.28, 3.70]; LLM-variant rate RR 3.91 [1.84, 8.29] vs neutral 1.17 [0.70, 1.94].
robust_findings.caveat: Associational; OR >= 2 depends on 'enhancing'; not sharply dated against 2023; the control null holds at the 2024 specification only.

robust_findings.claim: Title-style markers move more slowly among stayer keys than abstract-topic markers do (style-vs-topic channel contrast).
robust_findings.caveat: Declared profile keys, not persons; the slope criterion itself is not diagnostic.

robust_findings.claim: Measured team composition (size x new keys x LLM topic) does not account for most of the 2023-26 NAME rise.
robust_findings.evidence: DFL share 0.29 / 0.32 / 0.26 (2024/25/26), far below the 0.50 falsification line; Shapley share net of content 0.09.

robust_findings.claim: Retitled resubmissions do not add NAME on net.
robust_findings.caveat: Pairs are selected on retitling; a lag behind the population drift is not established.

robust_findings.claim: No title feature's acceptance association survives the camera-ready audit under multiplicity control.
robust_findings.evidence: 0 of 18 auditable features pass the Holm gate on 1,311 pre-decision arXiv pairs; NAME DiD +1.48 pp [-0.63, 3.59] vs tipping point 2.92 pp.
robust_findings.caveat: 'Not identified' is a statement about the audit, not evidence that editing explains the associations; ALL-CAPS, typography and the em dash cannot be audited through arXiv.

robust_findings.claim: A published-only study recovers mainstream title prevalences within 10% but halves the 2024 NAME slope change and under-represents outsider casing.
robust_findings.evidence: M 9/11 within +/-10% (effect scale); ITS break ratio 0.50 [-0.15, 1.16]; ALL-CAPS titles 0.36 [0.26, 0.47] of their all-submission share.
robust_findings.caveat: Outsider under-representation is not identified as selection (camera-ready recasing).

robust_findings.claim: Pre-decision stages deplete 'Enhancing X via Y'-type R24 title words, as they did before 2024; the other LLM-style markers are neutral in 2024-26.
robust_findings.caveat: Not evidence that review detects LLM use.

robust_findings.claim: The raw withdrawal excess of NAME papers is mostly topic composition.
robust_findings.evidence: +4.06 pp cross-section without topic FE; +0.84 [-1.05, 2.74] with topic100 FE.

robust_findings.claim: The camera-ready NAME audit, the findability gap and the absence of a camera-ready retitling excess are robust measurement facts about the arXiv audit itself.
robust_findings.evidence: Found 86.5% vs 53.1% (accepted vs rejected; OR 5.68); retitling +1.5 pp [-3.2, 6.1]; NAME does not predict findability (OR 1.00 [0.81, 1.22]).
robust_findings.caveat: Both retrieval routes share an abstract-similarity rule.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'Dated slope break at 2024 (pilot OR 1.28/yr)'
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Year-level CI on U includes 1 (1.096 [0.990, 1.214]); sup-LR picks 2023; null without 2026; 1.28 was for compound titles.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'Content explains only a minority (30-45%)'
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Name-masked content explains 0.37-0.65 depending on design and calibration.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'Unexplained drift accelerated from 1.7 to 3.9 pp/yr'
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Point estimate 1.5 -> 2.9 pp/yr; two-stage year-level CI [0.03, 2.71] pp fails Holm; absent in the NA pool and the non-LLM subset.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'Detectable LLM drafting adds little and is bounded from above'
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: 7% [1, 13] for the pre-registered fingerprint; 16-33% for other markers; the fingerprint fails D3's positive control (slot OR 1.29 [0.92, 1.81]).

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'The same people changed: communal change within incumbent authors'
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: A purely generational world with the observed co-authorship gives rho_last 0.88-0.93.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Newcomer-free teams rose >= 0.5x the population (H2c)
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: 0.34 [0.19, 0.48] x population at zero new co-author keys.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Communal change as the general (pre-LLM) mode (H2e)
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: IUT p 0.061 (Holm 0.122); email-era null 0.69-0.76.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Retitled papers lag the content-fixed drift (S2.1)
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Topic-adjusted -4.8 pp (p 0.057); same-key -3.4 pp (p 0.33).

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Tie contagion falsified by the future-tie placebo (S2.2)
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: The positive control is not detected in the primary specification.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'LLM register turns over in step with the model generation'
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: R24's 2026 fall is shared by neutral synonyms (1.08 [0.86, 1.36]); R26 selected in-sample.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Title register aligns with the abstract's LLM vintage (H3c)
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Without shared lemmas OR(F24 -> R24) = 1.00; the contrast is F26 papers avoiding R24.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'Lexical, not structural' LLM signature (H3d, ratio >= 1.5)
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Against the population NAME comparator 1.24 [0.99, 1.57]; F is associated with NAME (OR 1.14).

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Second-hand diffusion of LLM wording to non-users (H3e)
'Peer review neither creates nor amplifies the naming fashion'
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Amplification is not supported (editing-corrected centre 0.991; equivalence holds); whether the decision stage carries a small NAME premium is not identified.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'Review depletes LLM and outsider markers'
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: L-union total fails Holm (0.975 [0.951, 1.001]); the identified depletion is R24 and pre-dates 2024; O depletion is not identified as selection except ALL-CAPS at exit.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Published-only studies understate LLM use by >= 15%
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: IUT p 0.209; the falsification condition is met under a post hoc pre-ChatGPT baseline; the prereg CT10 gate now fails in the dry run.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: The withdrawal excess of named papers is between authors (H4d)
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: With topic100 FE the cross-sectional excess is +0.84 [-1.05, 2.74].

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Camera-ready retitling excess among accepted papers (+6 to +10 pp)
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Complete audit: +1.5 [-3.2, 6.1]; -2.7 pp where v1 was posted during review.

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: 'Consistent with LLM-assisted camera-ready polishing' of abstracts
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Abstract-editing DiD fell from +3.55 to +0.71 pp [-1.95, 3.36].

withdrawn_or_not_identified.claim: Acceptance associations of compound titles, sentence case or outsider casing
withdrawn_or_not_identified.why: Pass only the uncorrected audit rule; Holm p >= 0.29.
